programs.title: Interventional Cardiology Fellowship
programs.overview: A comprehensive interventional cardiology fellowship designed for MD/DNB Cardiology aspirants seeking advanced cath lab skills, complex PCI exposure, and structured mentorship at a high-volume cardiac centre.
eligibility: MD / DNB in General Medicine or Cardiology

programs.title: Clinical Cardiology Fellowship
programs.overview: Clinical cardiology fellowship focused on wards, CCU, echo basics and evidence-based cardiac care pathways.

programs.title: Neonatal Intensive Care Fellowship
programs.overview: Immersive NICU fellowship covering ventilator management, neonatal resuscitation, and care of extreme preterm infants under experienced neonatologists.

programs.title: Pediatric Critical Care Fellowship
programs.overview: Pediatric ICU fellowship with ventilator strategies, shock protocols and multidisciplinary case management.

programs.title: Critical Care Medicine Fellowship
programs.overview: Rigorous critical care fellowship focused on multi-organ support, emergency protocols, and evidence-based ICU practice across medical and surgical ICUs.
eligibility: MD / DNB in Medicine, Anaesthesia, Pulmonology or Emergency Medicine

programs.title: Emergency & Critical Care Fellowship
programs.overview: Emergency-focused critical care module for rapid decision making, triage and acute resuscitation skills.
eligibility: MD / DNB / equivalent in relevant specialty

programs.title: Diagnostic Radiology Fellowship
programs.overview: Structured radiology fellowship emphasising CT/MRI reporting, ultrasound, and interventional basics with daily case reporting under senior consultants.

programs.title: Joint Replacement Fellowship
programs.overview: Orthopaedic fellowship centred on primary and revision arthroplasty, peri-operative care, and surgical technique refinement.

programs.title: Advanced Obstetrics & Gynaecology Fellowship
programs.overview: Short intensive OBGYN fellowship covering high-risk obstetrics, laparoscopy fundamentals, and structured clinical mentorship.
eligibility: MD / MS / DNB in Obstetrics & Gynaecology

programs.title: Fellowship in Internal Medicine
programs.overview: Year-long internal medicine fellowship combining ward rounds, emergency modules, and specialist case studies for confident adult disease management.
eligibility: MD / DNB Internal Medicine or equivalent

programs.title: General Surgery Fellowship
programs.overview: Surgical fellowship offering supervised OT exposure, peri-operative care, and stepwise skill building in general surgery.
